messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy will likely remain a complex and evolving concept rather than vanishing entirely, as legal frameworks and technological safeguards continue to adapt to new threats. Privacy

Consciousness copying by the 2030s is highly improbable given the current lack of understanding regarding neural mapping and subjective experience, making such a feat decades or centuries away. Consciousness

Wireless Internet coverage expanding globally is very likely, driven by satellite constellations like Starlink and improved terrestrial infrastructure that aim to bridge the digital divide. Wireless

The transition to electric transport is extremely probable for personal vehicles and short-distance logistics, though heavy industry and aviation may retain other energy sources for longer. Electric

Climate change impacts becoming irreversible is already a reality for certain tipping points, such as ice sheet loss and species extinction, which cannot be undone regardless of future mitigation efforts. Irreversible

Physical money disappearing completely is less certain in the near term, as cash remains vital for financial inclusion and resilience during power outages or network failures. Money

Unlocking genetic secrets for centuries-long life spans is speculative and unlikely in our lifetime, as biological aging involves complex systems that are far from being fully decoded or manipulated. Secrets
